# Alex Batten

> Freelance .NET and full-stack software engineer based in Denmark. Available for
> contract work on backend services, REST APIs, enterprise and tax-authority
> integrations, multi-tenant SaaS, and AI features. Remote across the EU on CET.

Alex Batten holds a BEng in Software Technology from the Technical University of
Denmark (DTU). Most of his work is in C# and .NET with full-stack web, API and
enterprise integrations, and AI/ML data work. He publishes three .NET libraries on
NuGet under the Invarix name and speaks English and Danish.

Contact: alex.batten1234@gmail.com

## Published software

- [Invarix.Guard](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Invarix.Guard): A plug-and-play
  AI safety library for .NET. Covers prompt injection, PII, and content safety so
  applications can add guardrails in a few lines of code.
- [Invarix.Guard.Evidence](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Invarix.Guard.Evidence):
  A tamper-evident audit trail for AI decisions in .NET, free under Elastic
  License 2.0. Records decisions as CloudEvents keyed on SHA-256 hashes, seals
  batches into an RFC 6962 Merkle tree signed with the customer's own Ed25519 key,
  and runs fully in process with no outbound calls.
- [Invarix.Gate](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Invarix.Gate): A deterministic action
  firewall for AI agents in .NET. Evaluates an agent's tool calls against a policy
  before they run and returns allow, warn, escalate, deny, or terminate. Ten detectors
  covering destructive SQL, shell commands, git history rewrites, cloud teardown,
  credential egress, and runaway loops, each grounded in a dated public incident. Pure
  CPU pattern matching with no model call, median verdict 57 microseconds, deterministic
  under a given policy. Policy as YAML or fluent C#, with adapters for
  Microsoft.Extensions.AI and Microsoft Agent Framework. Observe mode is free under
  Elastic License 2.0. Currently 1.0.0-rc.1.
